title: deployment-readiness-weekly-briefing
summary: Scratchpad for the weekly deployment-readiness sync. Quick agenda, live risks, go/no-go criteria, owners for action items. Personal notes and TODOs — rough, will clean after meeting.
content:
Weekly deployment readiness — scratchpad (prep + follow-ups)

Date: Wed 2026-03-11 meeting prep (notes updated 2026-03-12)
Attendees (planned): Erin, Samir, Jules, Tori, Asha (oncall), Product PM (Dana) — confirm

Agenda (fast cadence)
- 5m: quick status (green/amber/red) from each owner
- 10m: blockers / migration plan check
- 10m: go/no-go checklist review + signoffs
- 10m: communication & post-deploy testing plan
- 5m: action items & owners

Quick status (my read)
- infra: amber — rolling restart test failed once in staging (Samir)
- runtime/model serving: green but perf regression in 2 long-tail cases (Jules)
- console/observability: green — dashboards updated, traces hooked (Tori)
- db migration: amber — final dry-run queued (Erin)
- docs/comms: draft ready (Dana)

Top open risks (summary)
1) Staging rolling restart flake — cause unknown (race in k8s preStop?) — if not resolved, risk of slow start on scale-up. Impact: medium-high. Owner: Samir.
2) E2E perf regression on long prompt paths — not blocking correctness, affects p99 latency. Owner: Jules. Need repro and mitigation (quantization knob/timeout).
3) DB migration edge case with old client shadow reads — rare but data mismatch risk. Owner: Erin.
4) Canary traffic routing policy not validated across regions (eu/us) — Tori to confirm.

Go / No-go checklist (one-line owners) — mark Y/N during sync
- Critical customer bug count = 0 (Product) — Dana
- All blocking Jira tickets triaged and assigned (<=2 blockers allowed) — Samir
- CI: release pipeline green (unit + smoke + e2e quick) — Jenkins/GH Action link — Jules
- Staging dry-run (full migration) successful — Erin
- Rollback plan tested & documented (playbooks) — SRE lead / Asha
- Oncall handoff & rota confirmed for 48h post-deploy — Asha/Tori
- Feature flags in place for immediate rollback of 1.2 endpoints — Dev leads
- Customer comms (status page + outbound) drafted and reviewed — Dana
- Observability: alert thresholds tuned and dashboard links shared — Tori

Checklist notes:
- If staging dry-run fails: pause, fix data migration script (see migration log id MIG-2026-03-10), then re-run.
- If perf p99 > target: consider scaled canary at 10% and postpone full rollout.

Action items (live)
- Samir: reproduce rolling restart flake in a smaller repro and attach trace (due 2026-03-13) — assigned
- Jules: capture perf repro case and run profiler, propose mitigation by Friday 2026-03-14 — assigned
- Erin: run final dry-run of DB migration tonight (2026-03-11) and upload results to Confluence — if fails, escalate immediately — assigned
- Tori: validate canary routing (eu/us) and post verification checklist in slack #deploy-notify by EOD 2026-03-11 — assigned
- Asha: confirm oncall for deploy window and run a drill of rollback procedure with dev small team (2026-03-12) — assigned
- Dana: finalize customer comms and prepare status page template (2026-03-12) — assigned

Notes to self / TODOs (personal style)
- Need to check PR #4192: does it change the startup args that could explain staging flake? quick skim looks like an env var rename — follow-up with author.
- Double-check whether we have automated migration dry-run webhook triggers; if not, add simple watch so CI alerts me.
- Question: do we want to flip feature flag gating on a header or on user-id? (tradeoffs: easier rollback vs config complexity) — bring to sync.

Meeting prep reminders (things to bring)
- Samir: logs + short 2-line summary of what fails and how reproducible (clip links)
- Jules: perf graphs for last 72h and a short repro script
- Erin: migration plan doc + raw migration logs + target window
- Asha: rollback playbook link and oncall list

During meeting: record these live decisions
- decision: if staging dry-run passes but perf gray area, do 10% canary for 24h before full rollout (tentative)
- decision: hold full rollout if rolling restart flake reproduces at >1/10 attempts

Post-meeting follow-up template (I will copy/paste)
- TL;DR status: green/amber/red + one-sentence explanation
- Actions assigned with due dates (copy from action list)
- Links to artifacts (confluence, PRs, JIRA)
- Deploy window & oncall list + comms plan

Open questions (to tidy up)
- Who signs off final go/no-go? (ops/eng lead?) -> propose: Erin + Samir (ops lead) + product PM (Dana)
- Do we need a legal/regulatory notif for this deploy? (data migration touches EU-based datasets) -> ask security/compliance next call

Freeform scratch (brain dump)
- If the k8s preStop hook is flaky, maybe add 10s grace window? but that masks problem; prefer fix.
- Consider running staging at 75% of prod load for one run to stress the new quant path. (Jules)

End of scratchpad. Will update after sync and convert to a clean post-meeting note.

-- Erin
